title: Compare input and resumable dispatch

acceptance.description: Compare UTF-8/character paths and resumable sink dispatch for byte/string callers and multilingual input.
Report conversion/allocation costs and demonstrate suspension inside a token without retaining full input.
Demonstrate the deliverable using only verified dependencies and this task; record actual API/output files and checks at the tested revision. Preserve earlier milestone behavior.

Benchmark cached SearchValues versus simple span scans; constant ReadOnlySpan/UTF-8 literals versus array-backed tokens; and length-dispatched equality versus collision-checked fixed-ASCII hashing. Cover byte/char input, hits/misses, short/long tokens, case rules, non-ASCII and chunk boundaries. Report cold/warm allocations and inspect lowering-dependent cases.

implementation: experiments/Input/Input.csproj; Program.cs: standalone net10.0 experiment with central BenchmarkDotNet 0.15.8 and explicit short exploratory job; no shared configuration changes

experiments/Input/Scanner.cs: borrowed generic byte/character fragment scanner, quantum+1 bounded delimiter search, consumed-unit pause/EOF contract, strict incremental UTF8/UTF16 sinks, bounded character scratch and explicit whole-conversion baselines
experiments/Input/Primitives.cs: cached SearchValues, static literal/local collection controls, length/equality and collision-checked fixed ASCII hashing, bounded overflow-checking chunk candidates

experiments/Input/Benchmarks.cs: 282 active cases across input/pause/rejection, scan, matcher/chunk, literal/lowering dimensions; Checks.cs: independent oracle, all short splits, invalid Unicode, culture/collision/random unknowns, long one-chunk progress
experiments/Input/Diagnostics.cs: cold/warm allocation regressions, 4 MiB paused source collectability, 64 MiB bounded streaming and IL inspection

docs/reports/M0-input-spike/results.md; matrix-summary.md; raw/suite-revisions.json; raw/active/; raw/superseded/: interpretation and durable revision-specific CSV/full JSON/raw logs; lowering-il.txt and lowering*-jit.txt; check_escape.py: compiler escape regression

evidence.summary: 83,095 assertions passed: all short byte/char splits, chunks 1..32, scalar carry/invalid Unicode, per-fragment pauses, independent oracle, exact/ASCII-fold matching, deliberate collisions, randomized unknowns/cultures, bounded candidate overflow, and long single-chunk tokens up to 1 MiB with bounded fragment/end/progress accounting. Search inspection confirms window bounded to quantum+1, avoiding repeated full-tail rescans. Synthetic token protocol, not XML correctness.
